drill.title: EventStorming Drill
drill.intro: Questions on the ideas in Alberto Brandolini's Introducing EventStorming, to prepare for facilitating a workshop. Read and tap in silence, or have them read aloud and answer by voice or with the car's steering-wheel buttons. The app explains each answer and remembers what you missed.
drill.examsText: Twelve workshop situations where every answer earns 5, 3, 1 or 0 points, with the reasons after each one. Then a 20-question readiness check with no feedback until the end.

lessons.title: EventStorming Audio
lessons.sub: 11 episodes · 10 lessons and a recap podcast · short quizzes with a pause so you can answer aloud
lessons.drillSub: 30 concept questions, 12 facilitation scenarios and a readiness check

episodes.t: What it is, and why it works
episodes.s: Silos, learning as the bottleneck, events, fuzziness, the three formats
Who to invite, hacking the room, materials, colors, agenda

episodes.t: Big Picture: from chaos to a timeline
episodes.s: Kick-off, chaotic exploration, icebreaker, sorting strategies, hot spots
People and systems, walkthrough, reverse narrative, value, arrow voting
Patterns and anti-patterns: committee, religion war, guess first, speak out loud…

episodes.t: From Big Picture to bounded contexts
episodes.s: Six heuristics for boundaries; merge the people, split the software
The picture that explains everything, policies, read models, magic words
Opening moves, rabbit holes, rush to the goal, aggregates, code early
DDD, CQRS and event sourcing, and how the colors map to code
What changes online, and the remote patterns from the book
Two hosts, the whole course, a checklist for the day, rapid-fire quiz

say.intro: EventStorming drill. After each question, say number one, two, three, or four, or words from the answer. Say repeat to hear the question again.
say.intro_buttons: EventStorming drill, with car buttons. I will read each option. Press next when you hear the one you want. Press previous to hear the question again.
say.exam_intro: EventStorming readiness check. Twenty questions, twenty minutes, and no feedback until the end. Answer each question by saying number one to four, or words from the answer.
say.exam_intro_buttons: EventStorming readiness check. Twenty questions, twenty minutes, and no feedback until the end. I will read each option. Press next on the one you want, then next again to confirm.
say.exam_pass: Well done. The target is fourteen out of twenty.
say.exam_fail: That is below the target of fourteen out of twenty. Review the missed questions.
say.p2_practice: EventStorming facilitation scenarios. Each answer earns five, three, one or zero points, and you hear why after each scenario. Answer by saying number one to four.
say.p2_practice_buttons: EventStorming facilitation scenarios. Each answer earns five, three, one or zero points. Press next on the option you want, then next again to confirm.
